description: Progress of one processing step for one language.

language.description: Language code the step runs for.

status.description: `pending`: not started or waiting for an external step to deliver. `in_progress`: running. `done`: finished. `failed`: stopped, see `errorCode` and `errorMessage`.

skipped.description: True when the language was intentionally not processed.

errorCode.description: Machine-readable reason, only set when `status` is `failed`.

errorMessage.description: Human-readable reason, only set when `status` is `failed`.
errorMessage.example: The processing could not be started. Please try again.

tmsJob.description: Translation management job that delivers this translation, present only when the translation runs through one.

status.description: State reported by the translation management system.
